bio_summary: Pranav Prince is an Indian professional basketball player from Kerala, born on June 19, 2003. He plays as a forward for the India men's national basketball team and represents Tamil Nadu in domestic tournaments. He made his senior international debut in 2021 and has since participated in various major competitions, including the FIBA Asia Cup and the Asian Games. Prince is recognized as one of India's promising young basketball talents.
